entry.title: Inside: Phone Check 1.21.2
entry.summary:
After a check, the results can set the charging clock to open when you plug in. No charger at hand? Choose “record it when I plug in” and the charging item is recorded the next time you connect one with Inside open. Bug fixes.
兩分鐘檢查跑完後的結果頁，可設定接上充電器就開啟充電時鐘。手邊沒有充電器時可選「之後接上時自動記錄」，下次接上充電器並開著機況時就會記錄。另修正了一些問題。

entry.title: Roomory: Floor Plans 2.5.0
entry.summary:
Roomory 2.5 • Draft a room from photos: pick 1–3 photos of a room and AI draws its walls, doors, windows and furniture for you to correct (3 free a month) • Box select: drag a box over furniture to move or delete it all at once • One-tap scan: Scan the Room on the home screen starts right away, no name needed • Site photos: keep site photos pinned on the plan, the video of each single-room scan and 3D scenes captured from photos in your project • A cleaner editor: the toolbar fits in one row and the room’s area shows beside its name • Deleting no longer asks first; undo it right on the plan • Design book: contents page, quote subtotals by room, wiring by circuit and switch-to-light lines on the lighting sheet
居圖 2.5 • 從照片畫房間：選 1–3 張房間照片，AI 畫出牆、門窗和家具，再自己修正（免費每月 3 次） • 框選：框住多件家具，一起移動或刪除 • 一鍵掃描：首頁點「掃描房間」直接開始，不用先取名 • 現場照片：專案裡存現場照片並釘在平面圖上，也存單一房間掃描時的錄影，還能用照片拍成 3D 場景 • 更簡潔的編輯畫面：工具列收成一排，房間名稱旁直接顯示面積與坪數 • 刪除物件不再跳確認，可直接復原 • 設計書：目錄、報價逐房間小計、逐迴路的線材，照明圖連出開關與燈

entry.title: Folkline: Forum Reader 1.1.5
entry.summary:
• Fixed posting, replying and editing getting stuck after PTT changed its save screen • Signed in, a board's newest page refreshes from PTT about every 45 seconds, so new and deleted posts show before the website catches up • Delete your own post with a left swipe or from the post's ⋯ menu • Fixed the app getting slower the longer it stayed open
・修正發文、回文、修改文章會卡住（PTT 更新了存檔畫面） ・登入後，看板最新一頁約每 45 秒直接從 PTT 更新，新文章和刪文不用等網頁版 ・左滑自己的文章或在文章 ⋯ 選單即可刪除 ・修正開著很久會越用越慢的問題

entry.title: Tuck: AI Screenshot Organizer 3.7.0
entry.summary:
After swiping through your screenshots, Tuck shows how much space the deleted ones took up, and you can share the result as a card. The Upcoming in Tuck widget shows how many screenshots are waiting. New users can start swiping right from the intro. Sorting is smarter too: receipts, tickets, warranty cards, restaurants, recipes and product pages are recognized more reliably, with better reading of screenshots in other languages such as Korean.
滑卡整理截圖後，會顯示刪掉的截圖有多大，還能把成果做成圖卡分享；「收好近期事項」小工具會顯示待整理的截圖數；首次使用可以直接從引導進入滑卡整理。 截圖分類也更準了：收據、票券、保固卡、餐廳、食譜和商品頁更能分對，韓文等外語截圖也讀得更準。

entry.summary:
When no ad is available, the ad space now shows one of our other apps. Bug fixes.
沒有廣告可顯示時，廣告位置會改為介紹我們的其他 App。另修正了一些問題。

entry.title: Daikon: Period Tracker 1.9.0
entry.summary:
New: your own tags, with pain relief and the pill built in; a daily pill reminder; and a little card of your next period to share with your partner from Today. Full-screen ads now appear at most once a day, never when you open the app. A small banner sits at the bottom of Diary and History.
新增：自訂標籤，止痛藥和避孕藥也能記；每日吃藥提醒；在「今天」把下次經期做成小卡分享給伴侶。全螢幕廣告改為每天最多一次，打開 App 時不會出現。「日記」與「你的記錄」底部新增一則小橫幅。

entry.title: Lockwater: Canal Puzzle 1.3.0
entry.summary:
New level map: sail your tug along a 3D canal through all 12 chapters, from sunny locks to night water, and watch it chug to each lock you open. When no ad is available, the ad space shows one of our other apps. Bug fixes.
全新關卡地圖：拖船沿著 3D 運河穿過全部 12 章，從陽光水閘到夜色水道，每開啟一道新水閘就開過去。沒有廣告可顯示時，廣告位置會改為介紹我們的其他 App。另修正了一些問題。
